tris_note: scene only; robot is the runtime model (~39k) -> ~58k with robot, budget 100k
size_note: 6.3 MB because three textures are embedded; compress to KTX2/WebP in the build step
textures: s04_city_dusk.png (Codex IMG-S04, unlit emissive card behind window mullions, M_City_Dusk)
s03_plant_fg.png (keyed foreground plant cards, M_Plant_Card, alpha)
lighting: none exported; lit in three.js. Blender review look: Standard + Medium High Contrast, exposure 0, Glare bloom, volume haze 0.0018, DOF f/2.8 focus 10 m; lights: window_dusk (warm area from window), platform_glow (mint point over platform), front_fill, rim_right point (6,-2,5)/300W Blender coords; L_phone_gold warm area (3.9,1.1,2.9)/450W light-linked to S04_phone only (gold rail highlight)

robot.note: runtime robot; reviewed render used identity rotation (yaw 0). Tablet + pen are runtime (not in the kit); head pose is runtime

phone: S04_phone_details (speaker holes, USB-C, side buttons, camera bump + 3 lenses)

open_notes: mid panel upper-right header/grid at gate edge (123-130%): dim slightly if touched again
right racks darker than ref (79%): cosmetic

holo_yaw_deg.note: Blender Euler XYZ deg; each -Y face turns toward the robot head (Blender -3.6,-3.4)

beam_note: M_Beam is additive (Transparent + Emission via Add Shader, strength 0.14 -> 0 upward); in three.js use AdditiveBlending, depthWrite false, so it never veils the phone
orbit_note: S04_orbit is a thin light trail: tube radius 0.0022 x scale 3.6 = ~8 mm, M_Orbit emission 1.0; soften with bloom in code, do not thicken

phone_pose.note: on-screen box 1030-1311 x 273-663 px vs ref 1030-1310 x 275-660 (hero camera, 1671x941)

cameraSafeRange.criterion: No new S04_city edge ID in viewport; every hero-visible edge remains visible and its clipped endpoint coordinates move at most 0.02 frame widths horizontally and 0.02 frame heights vertically.
cameraSafeRange.coordinates: yaw around Blender world +Z, pitch around camera local +X, dolly along hero forward; combined yaw then hero rotation then pitch; glTF and three.js world up is +Y, equivalent to Blender world +Z for yaw

phone_exploded_parts_note: phone_exploded_parts supersedes the legacy props.phone summary for assembly nodes.

portrait_framing.note: S04_city dusk card limits safe camera box to ±0.79° yaw/pitch and ±0.079m dolly on 16:9; portrait pullback beyond 0.079m requires widened S04_city backdrop or static portrait framing.
